description: Use this when someone needs to know about a Spanish town's cadastral values: the year of its last general revaluation, whether that means the 1.1% or the 2% imputed-income rate for a tax year (pass the revised value to estimate_modelo_210), and its urban IBI rate on homes. From the Catastro's statistics and the Ministerio de Hacienda's open data; País Vasco and Navarra aren't covered.

ine.description: The town's 5-digit INE code, instead of town and province (e.g. 29069 for Marbella).

language.description: Language of the CasitaTax pages linked in the answer: da, de, en, es, fr, nl, no, fi or sv. Default en.

province.description: The town's province (e.g. Málaga, Alicante, Illes Balears, Santa Cruz de Tenerife), or its 2-digit code. Needed with town.

tax_year.description: Tax year (the year the income relates to). Default: the latest year whose rules are final.

town.description: The municipality's name, in Spanish or in the regional language (e.g. Marbella, Jávea or Xàbia). Not a district or an urbanisation: the town it belongs to.

name: town_cadastral_data
title: Town cadastral data
